# Yuyang RNA-seq processing
# Two sequencing runs: MS240610 and MS240819
# TPM files contain S. cerevisiae and Candida spike-in rows
# Metadata maps library_id to gene_tagged, size, treatment
# For GBA: calculate log2FC (PhIAA_1hr / DMSO_1hr) per gene per factor per size
# Output: tables/df_yuyang_gba.txt

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/Users/caitlinwaterworth/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofBath/YM_combined_analysis/EU_combined_analysis")
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r load-metadata}
df_meta <- read_excel("tables/YM_RNA_seq_combined_metadata.xlsx")

cat("Total libraries:", nrow(df_meta), "\n")
cat("Folders:", paste(unique(df_meta$folder), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Factors:", paste(unique(df_meta$gene_tagged), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Treatments:", paste(unique(df_meta$treatment), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r load-tpm}
# Load both TPM files, filter to S. cerevisiae, use column 3 as gene_id
# Extract library_id from column names using regex

load_tpm <- function(path, folder) {
  df <- read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(`#` == "S_cerevisiae") %>%
    dplyr::select(-`#`, -`...2`) %>%
    dplyr::rename(gene_id = `...3`)

  # Pivot to long format
  df_long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "col_name", values_to = "TPM") %>%
    mutate(
      # Extract library_id -- appears as MS######L## pattern
      library_id = str_extract(col_name, "MS\\d+L\\d+"),
      folder     = folder
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(library_id)) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, library_id, folder, TPM)

  cat(folder, "- genes:", length(unique(df_long$gene_id)),
      "libraries:", length(unique(df_long$library_id)), "\n")
  df_long
}

df_tpm_819 <- load_tpm("tables/MS240819_TPM.txt", "MS240819")
df_tpm_610 <- load_tpm("tables/MS240610_TPM.txt", "MS240610")

df_tpm_all <- bind_rows(df_tpm_819, df_tpm_610)
cat("Total gene-library observations:", nrow(df_tpm_all), "\n")
```

```{r join-metadata}
# Join TPM with metadata to get gene_tagged, size, treatment
df_joined <- df_tpm_all %>%
  inner_join(df_meta, by = c("library_id", "folder"))

cat("Observations after metadata join:", nrow(df_joined), "\n")
cat("Factors present:", paste(unique(df_joined$gene_tagged), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Check join worked -- should have same n libraries as metadata
cat("Libraries matched:", length(unique(df_joined$library_id)), 
    "of", nrow(df_meta), "\n")
```

```{r filter-conditions}
# Keep only DMSO_1hr (control) and PhIAA_1hr (1hr depletion)
# Exclude PhIAA_30min and any rapamycin conditions
# Keep only G1-arrested conditions (1.5hr = small, 8hr = large)
# Exclude WT from depletion FC calculation

df_filtered <- df_joined %>%
  filter(treatment %in% c("DMSO_1hr", "PhIAA_1hr")) %>%
  filter(gene_tagged != "WT")

cat("Factors after filtering:", paste(unique(df_filtered$gene_tagged), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Sizes:", paste(unique(df_filtered$size), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r compute-fc}
# Calculate mean TPM per gene per factor per size per treatment
# Then log2FC = log2(mean_PhIAA / mean_DMSO)
# Add pseudocount of 1 to avoid log(0)

df_fc <- df_filtered %>%
  group_by(gene_id, gene_tagged, size, treatment) %>%
  summarise(mean_TPM = mean(TPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = mean_TPM) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DMSO_1hr), !is.na(PhIAA_1hr)) %>%
  mutate(log2FC = log2((PhIAA_1hr + 1) / (DMSO_1hr + 1))) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_tagged, size, log2FC)

cat("Gene-factor-size combinations:", nrow(df_fc), "\n")
df_fc %>% dplyr::count(gene_tagged, size) %>% print()
```

```{r pivot-wide}
# Pivot to wide format: one column per factor-size combination
# Column names: log2FC_[factor]_[size]_YM
# Filter to standard yeast ORFs only (gene_id starts with Y)

df_yuyang <- df_fc %>%
  mutate(variable = paste0("log2FC_", gene_tagged, "_", size, "_YM")) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, variable, log2FC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = log2FC) %>%
  filter(grepl("^Y", gene_id))

cat("Genes in output table:", nrow(df_yuyang), "\n")
cat("Variables:", paste(colnames(df_yuyang)[-1], collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r qc}
# Quick correlation check between replicates within each factor
# Summary of log2FC distributions
df_fc %>%
  group_by(gene_tagged, size) %>%
  summarise(
    median_fc = median(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_fc   = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
    n         = n(),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()
```

```{r save}
write.table(df_yuyang, "tables/df_yuyang_gba.txt",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
cat("Saved tables/df_yuyang_gba.txt\n")
```
